title: Base change of vector integration counits
statement: For an independently integration-normalized vector purity family, the full prescribed base-change compatibility law holds, with the canonical source comparison and actual exceptional mate. This is one compatibility clause, not the vector-bundle purity theorem.

source.place: paragraph 2; assembly step 3, normalized transpose in the published vector-purity coordinates

proof.text: Choose the independent normalized primed family from vectorBundleNormalized. Apply the component projection/normalization/mate calculation, which uses the scalar Cartesian integration trace identity, to every object of the bounded constructible full subcategory. The component calculation already proves both the exceptional exchange isomorphism and the specified equation.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 2: scalar trace compatibility, projection exchange, and transposition; explicit generic mate-counit argument
